market_summary: Strong macro divergence across asset classes during London/NY Overlap. US100 rallied into Call Wall #1 dealer resistance under a positive gamma dampening regime, while GBPUSD and BTCUSD suffered heavy trend selloffs below their respective Value Area Lows and VWAP baselines. All three instruments are currently extended into major session boundaries or resistance walls, recommending HOLD across the board until pullbacks or clean structural breakouts establish.

signals.rationale: Price is trading below VAL (1.32557) and far below POC (1.32731). CVD is BEARISH (-11,131) with negative slope (-750.7), confirming heavy selling pressure. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price remains well below downward-sloping VWAP (1.32608) and EMA50 (1.32617). ATR channel is expanding with price probing the lower ATR band (1.32333). RVOL is 1.601 with no yellow breakout spike on the last bar. The latest closed bar and forming bar staged a minor bounce off Session Low (1.32210), leaving price extended into support and presenting poor immediate risk/reward for fresh short continuation.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below VWAP and falling EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is above VAH (28204.82) and above POC (28115.97). CVD is NEUTRAL (+2.10). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP.
